statements.status_notes: event-listener 5.4.1 is a transitive dependency embedded in the uv/uvx binaries from the DHI uv package. RUSTSEC-2026-0221 is fixed in event-listener 5.4.2. Because the uv package build uses Cargo's locked dependency graph, remediation requires updating the lock file to event-listener 5.4.2 or later, publishing a new DHI uv package, and rebuilding sbx-templates against it.

event-listener 5.4.1 is a transitive dependency embedded in the uv/uvx binaries from the DHI uv package. RUSTSEC-2026-0221 is fixed in event-listener 5.4.2. Because the uv package build uses Cargo's locked dependency graph, remediation requires updating the lock file to event-listener 5.4.2 or later, publishing a new DHI uv package, and rebuilding sbx-templates against it.

NiFi embeds uv 0.12.2, whose binary contains event-listener 5.4.1. event-listener 5.4.2 fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0221, but uv releases through 0.12.3 still use 5.4.1. Waiting for uv to adopt the patched transitive dependency; exploitability through uv has not been established.
